thread:
jess_support: Heads up — AcmeHealth can't pay INV-2026-089; invoice went to 'payment_hold'. Customer says they already paid a deposit but our PO field is blank. Asking for net30 approval while they sort VAT docs. pinging @finance-sara :wave:
finance-sara: Looking. Do we have a PO on file? I only see CC attempt failed with code 402 from Stripe yesterday. Any gateway logs?
payments-bot: Payment attempt ID pay_3JhYz failed: status=failed, code=card_declined, decline_code=insufficient_funds, network_status=declined. Timestamp=2087648000
jess_support: They emailed a remittance with a partial deposit (EUR 4,200) and want the remainder net30 because their procurement requires PO first. PO number in their email: ACME-PO-5542 but never added to billing. Attaching screenshot: https://files.redwood.example/attachments/2026-03/acme-remit.png
alex_pm: From product side: this customer is on Dedicated with reserved capacity, we've been billing monthly upfront historically for them. They negotiated a hybrid prepay + arrears arrangement in the contract. Contract section: "first month prepaid, subsequent invoices net30 on approved PO" — looks like the PO step stalled.
finance-sara: Ok. Two issues: (1) card declined -> we can retry if they want, (2) PO missing -> accounting needs PO to clear for net terms. Can we get AP to confirm PO matches invoice amount (EUR 12,600) and VAT id?
jess_support: Customer insists VAT ID on file is correct but invoice shows VAT 0% due to missing EU tax form. They uploaded VAT form earlier but maybe it wasn't attached to the invoice system. They want immediate access to prod if we clear net30.
raj_engineer: I pulled logs for invoice INV-2026-089 and payment webhook. Repro steps: 1) Create invoice via billing-service v2.4.1 2) Simulate payment via gateway sandbox with card token tok_decline 3) webhook delivered OK but billing-service marked hold because `po_number == null` and `vat_verified == false`. Relevant log excerpt:
```
billing-service: invoice INV-2026-089 created, amount=12600 EUR
payments: charge failed code=card_declined decline_code=insufficient_funds
billing-service: payment_state=failed -> hold_reason=missing_po,missing_vat
```
raj_engineer: We can patch to allow provisional net30 if finance flags invoice as 'provisional_approval' manually. That would let them continue serving while AP collects docs.
finance-sara: We can do a one-off provisional approval but need an email ack and PO number on the invoice to track exposure. Also need a note: exposure cap = EUR 8k until VAT verified. Who can update invoice metadata?
jess_support: I can ask customer for written ack now. @alex_pm can you confirm product ok with provisional access?
alex_pm: Product approves provisional access for one week max. No automation — must be manual flag set by billing. Suggest also a follow-up task to add PO to invoice and attach VAT form.
finance-sara: I'll temporarily bump credit via accounting console. Steps for ops (for billing team): 1) Update invoice metadata: add `external_po=ACME-PO-5542` and `status=provisional_approved` 2) Add note: "Provisional net30 cap EUR 8000 pending VAT verification" 3) Retry card charge after customer confirms retry. 4) If card still declines, create AR case for collection.
payments-bot: Accounting action required: set_provisional(invoice=INV-2026-089, limit=8000) -> ticket #AP-3321 created by finance-sara
jess_support: Customer provided signed email confirming PO and acking provisional cap, attached: https://files.redwood.example/attachments/2026-03/acme-ack.pdf
finance-sara: Done. Set provisional_approved and added PO to invoice. I've documented exposure and linked ticket AP-3321. Please note: VAT still pending — block for reclaim until we get EU VAT form.
raj_engineer: I've flagged billing-service to accept `provisional_approved` in the payment flow so it won't auto-hold on missing_po during the next reconciliation run. Patch pushed to staging and queued for hotfix to prod.
alex_pm: Thanks. Can support/finance confirm timeline? Customer wants access restored now.
finance-sara: Restored service access now. Will monitor charges. Card retry scheduled in 2 hours. If retry fails, escalate to collections as per AP process.
jess_support: Customer confirmed access restored, thanks team :tada:
finance-sara: Closing loop — if VAT form arrives, attach to invoice and we'll lift provisional cap and move to net30 normal flow. If not received in 14 days, collections outreach.
raj_engineer: Follow-up action: create small runbook for provisional approvals so on-call knows how to toggle flags (will add to docs).
jess_support: Adding notes to the support ticket and marking thread resolved. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
